name: hand/boil-hf
title: Hand-Drawn Boil
desc_vi: Hiệu ứng nét vẽ tay rung, đổi dáng mỗi vài khung theo hash cố định, tua chính xác.
params_vi: duration: độ dài của block (6 s) · replace: các cặp [chữ gốc, chữ mới] đổi nội dung trước khi chạy (ví dụ tiếng Việt)
notes: Run as shipped: the block's own page (assets/demo.html) in an iframe, its timeline set from the film's time. Fonts: Google / fontsource families are drawn with the kit's RFlex / RMono. Shown through the component's own demo page (a full composition). To apply the snippet to the film's own elements, ask Claude: the snippet is in assets/hw-boil.html. Source: Hand-drawn jitter that re-poses every N frames, as seek-safe helpers: pose derives from quantized timeline time through a seeded hash; includes the shared onUpdate dispatcher, a wobbled-ellipse path generator, the boil pose control (off/calm/lively over the family-locked frameDrop), a curvature-adaptive pen-velocity ease, and the completed stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray — spray is index-seeded deterministic dots, no turbulence) with texture-safe draw-on Renamed from hand/boil (09/10/2026): that name is the kit motion preset hand/boil; the two shared one gallery clip.
